WITH CharterSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, CharterNumber
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CharterSchoolNumber IS NOT NULL
),
AverageScores AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore
  FROM satscores s
  JOIN CharterSchools cs ON s.CDSCode = cs.CDSCode
  WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode
)
SELECT cs.CDSCode, cs.CharterNumber, avgwriteScore, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avgwriteScore DESC) AS Rank
FROM CharterSchools cs
JOIN AverageScores as avg ON cs.CDSCode = avg.CDSCode

  SELECT uuid, COUNT(rulings.uuid) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards
  LEFT JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
  GROUP BY cards.uuid
  ORDER BY ruling_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

FROM cards c
JOIN MostRulings mr ON c.uuid = mr.uuid

WITH RulingCount AS (
  SELECT
    c.name,
    c.artist,
    COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count,
    c.isPromo
  FROM
    cards c
  LEFT JOIN
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
  GROUP BY
    c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
),
MaxRulingCount AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ruling_count) AS max_ruling_count
  FROM
    RulingCount
)
SELECT
  rc.name,
  rc.artist,
  rc.isPromo
FROM
  RulingCount rc
JOIN
  MaxRulingCount mrc ON rc.ruling_count = mrc.max_ruling_count

WITH ConsumptionData AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.CustomerID,
    SUM(t2.Amount) AS TotalAmount,
    t3.Consumption AS Consumption_2012,
    t3.Consumption AS Consumption_2013
  FROM 
    transactions_1k t1
  JOIN 
    products t2 ON t1.ProductID = t2.ProductID
  JOIN 
    yearmonth t3 ON t1.CustomerID = t3.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    t1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t1.Amount = 634.8
  GROUP BY 
    t1.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  (Consumption_2012 - Consumption_2013) / Consumption_2012 AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
  ConsumptionData

WITH AwayWinCount AS (
  SELECT 
    away_team_api_id,
    COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM 
    Match
  WHERE 
    league_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League'
    ) AND 
    season = '2009/2010' AND 
    SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0
  GROUP BY 
    away_team_api_id
)
SELECT 
  T.team_long_name
FROM 
  Team AS T
JOIN 
  AwayWinCount AS AW ON T.team_api_id = AW.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY 
  AW.win_count DESC
LIMIT 1

  SELECT T2.team_api_id, T2.team_long_name, T2.buildUpPlaySpeed
  FROM League AS T1
  JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.country_id
  GROUP BY T2.team_api_id, T2.team_long_name
  ORDER BY T2.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
  LIMIT 4
)

FROM TopTeams AS T1
```sql
JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id;
```

WITH HighestFinishing AS (
  SELECT T1.player_api_id, AVG(T2.finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
  JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
  GROUP BY T1.player_api_id
  ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
ShortestHeight AS (
  SELECT T1.player_api_id
  FROM Player AS T1
  ORDER BY T1.height ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
HighestAndShortest AS (
  SELECT T1.player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
  JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
  WHERE T2.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
  OR T2.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id THEN 'highest' ELSE 'shortest' END AS answer
FROM HighestFinishing AS T1
JOIN HighestAndShortest AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

WITH LastDriverFinished AS (
  SELECT T1.time, T2.time AS champion_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = 1 AND T2.position = 2
  AND T1.year = 1988 AND T2.year = 1988
  AND T1.circuitRef = 'Melbourne'
),
IncrementalTime AS (
  SELECT T1.time - T2.time AS incremental_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN LastDriverFinished AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = 2 AND T1.year = 1988 AND T1.circuitRef = 'Melbourne'
)
SELECT (INCREMENTAL_TIME / champion_time) * 100 AS faster_percentage
FROM IncrementalTime

sql:
WITH LatestChampion AS (
  SELECT 
    r.year,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    r.time
  FROM 
    results r
  JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN 
    constructorStandings cs ON r.constructorId = cs.constructorId
  WHERE 
    r.year < 1975
    AND cs.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY 
    r.year DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  lc.year,
  AVG(TIME_TO_SEC(lc.time)) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
  LatestChampion lc
GROUP BY 
  lc.year

sql:
WITH qualifying_2000_to_2005 AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId IN (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
  )
),
drivers_1985_before AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob < '1985-01-01'
),
drivers_50_laps_completed AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM results
  WHERE laps > 50
),
common_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM qualifying_2000_to_2005
  INTERSECT
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers_1985_before
  INTERSECT
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers_50_laps_completed
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(driverId) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS percentage
FROM common_drivers

WITH DriverPitStops AS (
  SELECT 
    d.forename, 
    d.surname, 
    AVG(p.duration) AS avg_pit_stop_duration
  FROM 
    drivers d
  JOIN 
    pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
  WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Germany' AND 
    YEAR(d.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
  GROUP BY 
    d.forename, d.surname
),
TopDrivers AS (
  SELECT 
    forename, 
    surname, 
    avg_pit_stop_duration
  FROM 
    DriverPitStops
  ORDER BY 
    avg_pit_stop_duration ASC
  LIMIT 3
)

  surname, 
  avg_pit_stop_duration
FROM

```sql
  SELECT 
    d.forename, 
    d.surname, 
    AVG(p.duration) AS avg_pit_stop_duration
  FROM 
    drivers d
  JOIN 
    pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
  WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Germany' AND 
    YEAR(d.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
  GROUP BY 
    d.forename, d.surname
),
TopDrivers AS (
  SELECT 
    forename, 
    surname, 
    avg_pit_stop_duration
  FROM 
    DriverPitStops
  ORDER BY 
    avg_pit_stop_duration ASC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  forename, 
  surname, 
  avg_pit_stop_duration
FROM 
  TopDrivers;
```

)

FROM label_counts
ORDER BY label_count DESC
LIMIT 1
